merchant/31980.htm.text: Amulet Seller Rumba: You're a jumpy little frizbat, aren't you?! You'll be off the edge before long, no doubt! I'll wager I have just the thing for your overzealousness! So, what'll it be?

links.text: "Who is the lord of the manor and what is the tax rate?"
